text: The slot holds the head `sentences` for `tinyclip-8m-16` (species_com), fitted on `none (sentence rows only)`, with 5911 species rows. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025.wasm-int8-per-channel`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 100, w_kind 0.5, alpha_prior 1. On 1803 tuning photos (val) the thresholds came out as name_at 0.56 and offer_at 0.63. On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 77.3% (76.1 to 78.6); the top species is right for 26.4% (25.1 to 27.8) and is among the first five for 45.4% (43.9 to 46.9). `person` was said for 0.07% of these photos and `none` for 0.26%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind phrases`. With kind_at 0.80 (set on wildlife tuning photos and the extra set's tuning third), the page asserts a kind for 42.5% (41.0 to 44.1) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 97.4% (96.7 to 98.1) of those; for the 57.5% (55.9 to 59.0) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 91.4% (90.2 to 92.5). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds.wasm-int8-per-channel`), the kind is right for 83.1% (81.0 to 85.2); the page asserts a kind for 28.1% (25.7 to 30.6) and is right for 96.8% (94.8 to 98.6) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for 90.2% (88.3 to 92.1). A species is named on 0.8% (0.3 to 1.4) of these photos. The slot needs: fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).
